dogecoin.text: Wouldn't be surprised if $DOGE drops as low as 0.30. the question is how many times does it pump and dump before people get bored of losing money?
The market is a cruel mistress but there will be 1 of 2 lessons on $DOGE, either Hodl and don't look at the price or learn to rip the band aid off sooner and cut your losses.
